newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Foreigners lured by Albanian women - but beware.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners lured by Albanian women - but beware.

text.p: Foreigners are falling for Albanian women in droves, lured by the Balkan belles' calmness, loyalty and good cooking, an Albanian daily said on Thursday.
Inquiries from abroad and a growing interest among scores of Albanian women aged from 17 to 60 had prompted entrepreneurs to set up a marriage agency, the daily Koha Jone reported.
The Orchidea agency has notched up some successes, including matching a 55-year-old widow with an Italian although she did not speak a word of his language.
But a note of caution. One Albanian man filed for divorce in July after being regularly beaten by his spouse.
A judge dissolved the marriage minutes after the woman beat her husband unconscious in the courtroom.
